english.note: Use this when describing an action deliberately done for a reason, rather than something merely meaningful or goal-oriented.

examples.english: I made a purposeful decision to buy this book because I want to learn Cantonese.
examples.traditional: 我特登買呢本書嘅，因為想學好廣東話。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 maai5 ne1 bun2 syu1 ge3 jan1 wai6 soeng2 hok6 hou2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
